units.source_text: 源氏一经表明了恋慕之情以后，

en.t: After Genji had once made his feelings of love clear,

units.source_text: 不像古歌中所咏那样“决心启口又迟疑”，

en.t: he did not, like the old poem says, resolve to speak and then hesitate,

units.source_text: 便继续向玉鬘求爱，缠绕不休。

en.t: but went on courting Tamakazura and would not stop pressing her.

units.source_text: 玉鬘越发周章狼狈，忧愁之极，

en.t: Tamakazura grew still more flustered and distressed, and her sorrow reached its height,

units.source_text: 似觉置身无地，后来竟生病了。

en.t: as though she had no place left for herself, and in the end she fell ill.

units.source_text: 她想：“知道实情的人很少。

en.t: She thought, "Very few people know the truth.

units.source_text: 不论亲疏，都相信他真是我的父亲。

en.t: Whether close to me or distant, everyone believes that he truly is my father.

units.source_text: 如今此种事情倘使泄露出去，

en.t: If this sort of thing were to leak out now,

units.source_text: 便成天下一大笑柄，而我从此身败名裂了！

en.t: it would become a great laughingstock for the whole world, and I would be ruined in body and reputation forever!

units.source_text: 父亲内大臣一旦找到了我，

en.t: Even if my father, the Inner Minister, were to find me,

units.source_text: 本来不见得会当作亲生女儿一般疼爱我，

en.t: he might not necessarily cherish me as he would his own daughter,

units.source_text: 何况听到此种消息，一定把我看作一个轻狂女子了。”

en.t: and if he heard such news, he would certainly regard me as a frivolous woman."
She turned it over and over in her mind, unable to find any peace.

units.source_text: 兵部卿亲王和髭黑大将听说源氏并不厌弃他们，

en.t: Prince Hyobukyo and the bearded General heard that Genji did not reject them,

units.source_text: 便更加诚恳地向玉鬘求爱。

en.t: and so they courted Tamakazura with even greater earnestness.

units.source_text: 以前咏“犹似岩中水”的柏木中将，

en.t: Kashiwagi, the Middle Captain who had once composed the poem about water hidden in rock,

units.source_text: 从见子那里隐约闻知源氏容许他，

en.t: heard vaguely through Miko that Genji would allow him,

units.source_text: 只因不知实情，独自欢喜雀跃，

en.t: and because he did not know the truth, he rejoiced and exulted all by himself,

units.source_text: 只管向玉鬘申情诉恨，弄得迷离颠倒。

en.t: doing nothing but pouring out his feelings and grievances to Tamakazura until he was utterly bewildered and distraught.
